introduction_markdown:
**Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Further Mathematics 3 (0775), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2020. Duration: two and a half hours.**

Answer ALL questions. For your guidance the approximate mark allocation for parts of each question is indicated in brackets. Mathematical formulae and tables, published by the Board, and noiseless non-programmable electronic calculators are allowed. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage.

The paper contains eight questions.
enonce_intro_markdown:
A system of forces $\mathbf{F}_1, \mathbf{F}_2$ and $\mathbf{F}_3$ acting through points with position vectors $\mathbf{r}_1, \mathbf{r}_2$ and $\mathbf{r}_3$ respectively, where

$$\mathbf{F}_1 = (3\mathbf{i} - 3\mathbf{j} + 4\mathbf{k})\,\mathrm{N},\qquad \mathbf{r}_1 = (\mathbf{i} + \mathbf{j} + \mathbf{k})\,\mathrm{m}$$
$$\mathbf{F}_2 = (3\mathbf{i} + 4\mathbf{j} + 3\mathbf{k})\,\mathrm{N},\qquad \mathbf{r}_2 = (3\mathbf{i} + 2\mathbf{j} + \mathbf{k})\,\mathrm{m}$$
$$\mathbf{F}_3 = (-4\mathbf{i} - 2\mathbf{j} + \lambda\mathbf{k})\,\mathrm{N},\qquad \mathbf{r}_3 = (2\mathbf{i} - \mathbf{j})\,\mathrm{m}$$

reduces to a couple $\mathbf{G}$ and a single force $\mathbf{F} = (2\mathbf{i} - \mathbf{j} + 8\mathbf{k})\,\mathrm{N}$ acting through the point with position vector $\mathbf{r}_0 = (2\mathbf{i} - \mathbf{j} + 2\mathbf{k})$.

Find
incertitudes: Question 5 : le sujet ne précise pas l'unité de r_0 (les vecteurs position r_1, r_2, r_3 sont en mètres) ; le corrigé la prend en mètres.

questions.corrige_markdown:
The single force $\mathbf{F}$ of the reduction is the vector sum of the three forces:
$$\mathbf{F} = \mathbf{F}_1 + \mathbf{F}_2 + \mathbf{F}_3
= (3+3-4)\mathbf{i} + (-3+4-2)\mathbf{j} + (4+3+\lambda)\mathbf{k}
= 2\mathbf{i} - \mathbf{j} + (7+\lambda)\mathbf{k}.$$

(The $\mathbf{i}$ and $\mathbf{j}$ components $2$ and $-1$ agree with the given $\mathbf{F}$.) Equating the $\mathbf{k}$ components with $8$:
$$7 + \lambda = 8$$

$$\boxed{\,\lambda = 1\,}$$

questions.enonce_markdown: the vector moment of $\mathbf{F}_2$ about the point with position vector $\mathbf{r}_0$. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The moment of $\mathbf{F}_2$ about the point $\mathbf{r}_0$ is $(\mathbf{r}_2 - \mathbf{r}_0)\times\mathbf{F}_2$, where
$$\mathbf{r}_2 - \mathbf{r}_0 = (3-2)\mathbf{i} + (2+1)\mathbf{j} + (1-2)\mathbf{k} = \mathbf{i} + 3\mathbf{j} - \mathbf{k}.$$

$$(\mathbf{r}_2-\mathbf{r}_0)\times\mathbf{F}_2 =
\begin{vmatrix}\mathbf{i}&\mathbf{j}&\mathbf{k}\\ 1&3&-1\\ 3&4&3\end{vmatrix}
= \mathbf{i}(3\cdot3-(-1)\cdot4) - \mathbf{j}(1\cdot3-(-1)\cdot3) + \mathbf{k}(1\cdot4-3\cdot3)$$

$$= 13\mathbf{i} - 6\mathbf{j} - 5\mathbf{k}.$$

$$\boxed{\,\mathbf{M}_2 = (13\mathbf{i} - 6\mathbf{j} - 5\mathbf{k})\ \mathrm{N\,m}\,}$$

questions.enonce_markdown: the Cartesian equation of the line of action of $\mathbf{F}$. *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The line of action of $\mathbf{F}$ passes through the point $\mathbf{r}_0 = (2,-1,2)$ and has direction vector $\mathbf{F} = (2,-1,8)$. A point $(x,y,z)$ on it satisfies $\mathbf{r} = \mathbf{r}_0 + t\mathbf{F}$, i.e. $x = 2+2t$, $y = -1-t$, $z = 2+8t$. Eliminating $t$:

$$\boxed{\,\frac{x-2}{2} = \frac{y+1}{-1} = \frac{z-2}{8}\,}$$

(equivalently $\dfrac{x-2}{2} = -(y+1) = \dfrac{z-2}{8}$).

questions.enonce_markdown: the magnitude of the couple $\mathbf{G}$. *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The system is equivalent to the single force $\mathbf{F}$ acting through $\mathbf{r}_0$ together with a couple whose moment is the total moment of the three forces about $\mathbf{r}_0$:
$$\mathbf{G} = \sum_{i}(\mathbf{r}_i-\mathbf{r}_0)\times\mathbf{F}_i,\qquad \mathbf{F}_3 = (-4,-2,1)\ \ (\lambda = 1).$$

**$\mathbf{F}_1$:** $\mathbf{r}_1 - \mathbf{r}_0 = (-1,\,2,\,-1)$,
$$(-1,2,-1)\times(3,-3,4) = \big(2\cdot4-(-1)(-3),\ (-1)\cdot3-(-1)\cdot4,\ (-1)(-3)-2\cdot3\big) = (5,\,1,\,-3).$$

**$\mathbf{F}_2$:** from part (ii), $(13,\,-6,\,-5)$.

**$\mathbf{F}_3$:** $\mathbf{r}_3 - \mathbf{r}_0 = (0,\,0,\,-2)$,
$$(0,0,-2)\times(-4,-2,1) = \big(0\cdot1-(-2)(-2),\ (-2)(-4)-0\cdot1,\ 0\big) = (-4,\,8,\,0).$$

**Sum:**
$$\mathbf{G} = (5+13-4)\mathbf{i} + (1-6+8)\mathbf{j} + (-3-5+0)\mathbf{k} = 14\mathbf{i} + 3\mathbf{j} - 8\mathbf{k}\ \mathrm{N\,m}.$$

**Magnitude:**
$$|\mathbf{G}| = \sqrt{14^2 + 3^2 + (-8)^2} = \sqrt{196+9+64} = \sqrt{269}$$

$$\boxed{\,|\mathbf{G}| = \sqrt{269} \approx 16.4\ \mathrm{N\,m}\,}$$
